description: This file defines a utility object `StringUtils` that provides methods to join a LinkedList into a String and to split a String into a LinkedList, acting as a helper for string and list operations within the project.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A utility object providing string and list transformation methods.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins the linked list into a single string using JoinUtils.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into a linked list using SplitUtils.
